name: Worm Empathy

source.title: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

text: You can connect with cave worms (and other worm-related creatures, at the GM's discretion) on a rudimentary level. You can use Diplomacy to Make an Impression on cave worms and to make simple Requests of them. In most cases, the cave worm's starting attitude is indifferent and they will give you time to establish contact.
